reasons: Membership API-key access, plan-dependent model entitlements, and the OpenAI-compatible endpoint are documented, but no Winter live gate has exercised this subscription surface.

admission.citation: https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html — Kimi Code's current model configuration documents the OpenAI-compatible Coding endpoint at https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1, membership API keys, and third-party tool use (retrieved 2026-09-19).

contextWindow.sourceRef: https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html — K3 up to 1048576 for higher tiers; Plus/Moderato limited to 262144

inputModalities.sourceRef: https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html — k3 supports image and video input plus text

outputModalities.sourceRef: WINTER DEFAULT: upstream declares no output modality for ANY model, so `text` is Winter's inference for a chat registry, NOT an upstream statement. Stamped `source: winter-default` — the `EvidenceSource` member added for exactly this — so a reader filtering evidence BY SOURCE does not get a Winter guess wearing an upstream label. See PROVENANCE.md.

toolLoopRequirement.sourceRef: https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/error-reference.html (read 2026-10-29): 400 "thinking is enabled but reasoning_content is missing in assistant tool call message at index 2" -- "This is a Kimi Code-specific field required when thinking mode is active. How to fix: Add the reasoning_content field to the assistant message in tool calls"

continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/error-reference.html (read 2026-10-29): 400 "thinking is enabled but reasoning_content is missing in assistant tool call message at index 2" -- "This is a Kimi Code-specific field required when thinking mode is active.
